notes.title: One month patch - November 18th
notes.content:
Hi everyone and thanks for getting into the wardrobe!

Thirty days have passed since the release of [b]Forgotten Hill The Wardrobe[/b] and here a small patch with the following fixes:

[list]
[*] Fixed some typos in English, German and Chinese texts and made some slight changes in Birds Language Manual and Forgotten Flavor instructions to make them more clear. 
[*] Fixed an issue in Chapter 3 that allowed to interact with cards while reading the clue paper in the Insect Race puzzle
[*] Fixed an issue that could reset music volume when starting to Chapter 1
[*] Added a fallback in case Steam fails to unlock an achievement (if the connection drops for example): just visit in-game achievement page and click on the achievement icon to force a call.
[/list]
Hope you are enjoying the journey.

notes.title: Sunday October 20th patch
notes.content:
Here are today's patch notes:
[list]
[*] fixed an issue that could have made the game crash in chapter 2.
[*] fixed a glitch with SFX in main menu that could reset sounds volume.
[*] changed some hints activation in chapter 2 that could have been misleading.
[*] fixed a few typos in English and Portuguese translations.
[/list]

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: October 19 patch
notes.content:

Please update when you can, Thanks!
